profile.summary: Eat Better by Design describes itself as a strategy and innovation agency that helps food companies, foodservice organizations and partner groups design evidence-based products, programs and strategies that help people eat better. Its work includes turning nutrition research into insights and using human-centered design to build health-focused solutions.
